contract: Automatic admission of a unique descriptor-free private_stream_1 route in a selected TS188 program with empty program descriptors and complete current single-section PMTs. The public demuxer binds the program to its PMT PID. Check the initial PMT and first eligible PES before scanning the rest of an admitted transport for any invalid PMT CRC or changed route. No PID is supplied by the caller.

The public FFmpeg DTS parser must delimit two original canonical big-endian core frames at elementary offset zero in the first PES, with matching positive sample rate, duration and standard AMODE. Each envelope is independently checked with a fresh streaming parser and copied lookahead. This establishes framing, not audio decoding.

Every operation includes automatic discovery, allocation, complete source parsing and full packet and metadata folding through physical EOF. The reference reopens the unchanged input after admission so its demuxer parser receives the complete prefix; it uses public APIs only, NOFILLIN, and no decoder or find_stream_info. There is no separate explicit-selection pass.

All seven inputs are complete transports. Three admissions pin the entire fold and EOF=true; four separately pinned refusals require zero packets, bytes and digest, EOF=false and a refusal from both workers. Each timing sample executes every configured repetition, including refused operations. Refusal text is diagnostic. Ordinary stock discovery and the existing explicit-selection corpus are unchanged.

Generate the inputs and record reference pins with cargo xtask fixture transport-dts-discovery FATE_DTS_TS --record REFERENCE. The source is FATE dts/dts.ts SHA-256 749561299cf838d55f52d5697f78c273a6c381c5e6c8300f859dfe23252ae2c2. The three byte mutations and CRC-correct duplicated route are generated in Rust from this pinned full input. Generated media remains outside git.
